critical-expected-v1.label: Critical rate expected value
critical-expected-v1.deltaFormulaSketch: expected added damage = eligible base damage * deltaCritChance * (critDamageMultiplier - 1)
requiredInputs: crit chance snapshot at hit time or active/inactive observed crit-rate delta
crit damage multiplier snapshot at hit time
eligible crittable hit count and observed crit flags
same damage/source/target lane baseline when validating contribution

lucky-expected-v1.label: Lucky strike expected value
lucky-expected-v1.formulaSketch: expected lucky multiplier = luckyChance * (0.4 + 0.25 * luckyChance) * (1 + luckyChance + lucky/general damage bonuses)
lucky-expected-v1.deltaFormulaSketch: expected added damage requires the parent hit base lane plus lucky chance, lucky multiplier, and lucky/general damage bonus snapshots
requiredInputs: lucky chance snapshot at hit time or active/inactive observed lucky-rate delta
lucky multiplier derived from lucky chance
lucky/general damage bonus snapshot at hit time
parent hit pairing or exact emitted lucky damage row when explaining observed final damage

validationPolicy.requiredComparison: same damage id, parent hit lane, source actor, target lane, and active/inactive source window
